selected_policy: Cigna ACDF (CMM-601: Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion)

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Symptoms include ANY of the following: upper/lower extremity weakness, numbness, or pain; fine motor dysfunction; gait disturbance; new-onset bowel or bladder dysfunction; frequent falls.
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Motor: Diffuse 4/5 upper extremity weakness, clumsiness buttoning shirts; Sensory: Loss of proprioception fingertips

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Physical exam findings include ANY of the following: grip and release test; ataxic gait; hyperreflexia; Hoffmann sign; Babinski sign; tandem walking test demonstrating ataxia; inverted brachial radial reflex; increased muscle tone or spasticity; clonus; myelopathic hand.

MRI/CT shows findings that are concordant with the individual's symptoms and physical exam findings and that are caused by EITHER of the following: cervical spinal cord compression; cervical spinal stenosis.
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: C4-C5 severe cervical spinal canal stenosis with cord compression and intrinsic T2 hyperintensity

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders).
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: No unmanaged major depressive disorder, psychiatric illness, or substance abuse disorder.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Documentation of nicotine-free status with EITHER of the following: individual is a never-smoker; individual has refrained from smoking... for at least six (6) weeks prior to planned surgery validated by objective cotinine testing methods... verified as within the normal range.
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: URINE COTININE SCREEN (LC-MS/MS) RESULT: Negative (<10 ng/mL); INTERPRETATION: Specimen confirms tobacco / nicotine abstinence (>6 weeks duration)

notes: The patient meets all medical necessity criteria for CMM-601.4 Myelopathy. The clinical presentation (weakness, fine motor dysfunction, hyperreflexia) is concordant with MRI findings of severe C4-C5 stenosis and cord compression. The patient has documented nicotine abstinence via objective testing. Although the physician note mentions a failure of conservative management (0 weeks PT), the Myelopathy section of the policy (S9.1.2) does not explicitly list a mandatory duration of conservative care (unlike the Radiculopathy section S9.1.1). Therefore, the absence of PT documentation does not result in a 'NOT MET' status for this specific policy section. The request is approved.
